note: DNB's price list for bank and credit cards (read 2026-10-30): DNB's Mastercard credit card is priced by the customer programme it belongs to: the DNB Mastercard (no programme; 19.2% a year nominal), Pluss Mastercard (18.6%), Ung Mastercard (for those 18 to 28; 18.6%), SAGA Mastercard and Private Banking Mastercard (18%), all with no annual price. Each: a cash withdrawal at a cash machine in Norway or abroad costs 40 kroner plus 1% (the Ung Mastercard's are free, nothing written), a 1.99% currency surcharge on purchases and withdrawals abroad, a 100-krone charge for going over the limit (overtrekk), and a 38-krone first reminder for a late payment, written as the late fee (the second reminder, 38 kroner, and the third, 113, aren't written). Membership of a programme and the Ung card's age range aren't checked by the game. The optional Mastercard Upgrade (59 or 169 kroner a month) and the extra-card, rush-card and paper-invoice prices aren't written; DNB's card page gives up to 45 interest-free days, written as each card's grace. The main banks: DNB, Norway's largest, is the only one written; Nordea's and SpareBank 1's Norwegian credit card pages weren't found at their addresses on 2026-10-30. The earlier reading of DNB's card page (2026-10-29: no annual fee, 19.20% nominal) holds and is kept.
